response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), status_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, telescope_count, 100.0 * telescope_count / (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM status_counts) AS share FROM status_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(s.telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.share) AS average_excess FROM status_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.share;
